no_adcom_quote.quote: In addition, no new safety concerns were identified for ospemifene. Therefore, no Advisory Committee was convened.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for OSPHENA (ospemifene, NDA203505). The Summary Review states that because the safety issues of estrogen agonist/antagonists are well known and adequately labeled, and no new safety concerns were identified for ospemifene, no Advisory Committee was convened. The Office Director memo and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review likewise confirm the application was not referred to an advisory committee, so there was no AdComm influence on the approval.
